quotes.text:
dwani.ai is a self-hosted, multimodal inference API designed for Indian Languages.

Interact using Text, Voice, Image and Documents for learning, analysis and exploration.

Detailed guide to self-host dwani.ai.     
https://github.com/dwani-ai/deploy

Link for Android App - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.slabstech.dhwani.voiceai&pcampaignid=web_share
